crossRefs.note: The sacrifice made by the wicked is an abomination to Yahweh, but the prayer of the upright is his delight.
A high look and a proud heart, the lamp of the wicked, is sin.
The sacrifice of the wicked is an abomination— how much more, when he brings it with a wicked mind!
He who increases his wealth by excessive interest gathers it for one who has pity on the poor.
To the pure, all things are pure; but to those who are defiled and unbelieving, nothing is pure; but both their mind…

translations.web: All food which may be eaten which is soaked in water shall be unclean. All drink that may be drunk in every such vessel shall be unclean.
translations.bsb: Any food coming into contact with water from that pot will be unclean, and any drink in such a container will be unclean.
translations.kjv: Of all meat which may be eaten, that on which such water cometh shall be unclean: and all drink that may be drunk in every such vessel shall be unclean.
translations.asv: All food therein which may be eaten, that on which water cometh, shall be unclean; and all drink that may be drunk in every such vessel shall be unclean.
